entry.title: dotnet/efcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-12-30
entry.content:
Issues

Closed

  • Cosmos db complex properties can be configured but are not working. #37297
  • Migrating EF6 app to EFCore 10 -- Stange bug ?? #37343
  • Q: Contrasting efcore with NHibernate re: inverse bidirectional parent-child collections #37209
  • Many to many relationship with date composite key returns duplicate results. #35882
  • Analyzer tests are accessing nuget.org #37106
    11.0.0
  • Move off of Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp.{Analyzer,CodeFix}.Testing.XUnit #35768
    11.0.0
  • Failed translating LINQ to SQL when using "let" keyword after "group by". #37402
  • [SQL Server] Fix application name telemetry for single-file deployment #37115
    11.0.0
  • Query Translation Issue with Optional ComplexProperty (Works with OwnsOne) #37030
  • Improve RelationshipConceptualNull message #37413
    11.0.0
  • Upgraded to 10.0.1 for the Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.InMemory breaks MongoDB.EntityFrameworkCore #37426

Updated

  • The SQL logged by EF doesn't reflect changes made by interceptors #37236
  • Add Cosmos support for complex types #31253
    11.0.0
  • Issue with AsNoTrackingWithIdentityResolution and JSON columns after upgrading to EF Core 9 #35468
    Backlog
  • GroupJoin in EF Core 9/10 returns single row for SQL Server temporal tables #37288
    Backlog
  • EF10 SQL Server: JSON types mapped to nvarchar(x) (non-MAX) no longer work #37424
    11.0.0
  • Support IReadOnlyList for Complex Collections #37405
    Backlog
  • SqlQueryRaw with GroupBy and First() projection generates invalid SQL with unreferenced parameter names #37409
  • Support complex types on entity types participating in inheritance hierarchies (TPH/TPT/TPC) #35025
    11.0.0
  • EF core tries to update Alternate Key SQL identity column. #32800
    Backlog
  • Migration generation fails for SqlVector<float> #37231
    11.0.0

PullRequests

Created

  • Fix SQLite decimal comparison with turkish culture #37429
    community-contribution

Merged

  • Fix up and reenable analyzer tests #37427
  • Inject SQL Server Application Name in a more robust way #37428
  • Improve the RelationshipConceptualNull exception message #37414

Updated

  • Allow SQL Server JSON mapping to non-max nvarchar #37425
  • Add runtime migration creation and application #37415
    community-contribution
